name: Nemotron-Terminal-8B
notes: Terminal agent fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Base Qwen/Qwen3-8B scores 2.47 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (Terminus 2) vs 13.0 tuned: +10.5 pts on the same scaffold. KV basis: Qwen3-8B base with terminal-agent fine-tuning, so the KV geometry is plain GQA and unchanged by the fine-tune. config.json: model_type qwen3, Qwen3ForCausalLM, hidden_size 4096, num_hidden_layers 36, num_attention_heads 32, num_key_value_heads 8 (gqa_ratio 4), head_dim 128 explicit, layer_types all 36 full_attention (no hybrid/sliding layers), max_position_embeddings 40,960, rope_scaling null, rope_theta 1e6, use_sliding_window false, torch_dtype bfloat16. 2 (K+V) x 36 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes = 147,456 B/token. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes Terminal-Bench 2.0 table; claimed 13.0% matches.
